value.rationale: The accepted theorem establishes a mathematically natural sharp first possible ground-set size for the failure of capacity-filling path-independent expansion, complementing a published six-applicant obstruction. Its complete capacity-three finite census gives 56,140 sources all covered by 80 targets, including 39,860 sources that violate the published sufficient law-of-aggregate-demand hypothesis, thus providing substantive information on an unresolved capacity regime.
